scope: D44: WPF template focus/hover triggers and width-linked repair count underline

libraries.verified: 2026-11-07 D44: WPF ControlTemplate.Triggers supports targeted setters on IsMouseOver and IsKeyboardFocused for named template elements; template names have their own XAML namescope, and a Line.X2 binding can reference a named TextBlock's ActualWidth inside that template. Context7 queries: ControlTemplate.Triggers IsKeyboardFocused Setter TargetName, and a Line whose X2 binds to ActualWidth with ElementName inside a template; WPF XAML inside ControlTemplate set Line.X2 with Binding ActualWidth ElementName Label.
